items.quote: This is my face every time someone asks: “But where’s the guarantee I’ll close my first deal this month?” ⸻ Article: “New office, same results?”
items.statement: This is my face every time someone asks: 'But where’s the guarantee I’ll close my first deal this month?'

items.quote: But here’s the question no one’s asking: What if it’s not about the company? What if it’s about the actions you haven’t taken yet?
items.statement: What if it’s about the actions you haven’t taken yet?

items.quote: Before you walk into another interview, before you scroll another job post, before you decide “maybe I just need a better platform”… Try this: Pick up the phone. Call every old lead.
items.statement: Pick up the phone. Call every old lead. Message people you’ve worked with in the past. Reach out for referrals.

items.quote: Or simply spend that time doing the one thing most agents avoid: working on your sales skills.
items.statement: Spend that time doing the one thing most agents avoid: working on your sales skills.

items.quote: Exactly the kind of work I break down every week on my YouTube channel — https://lnkd.in/dcUzHt3c
items.statement: I break down every week on my YouTube channel.

items.quote: And here’s the thought I’ll leave you with: Are you chasing change… or are you training for the result you say you want?
items.statement: Are you chasing change… or are you training for the result you say you want?
